metadata.description: risense-ai plugins for Qoder. Current plugin: respire-qoder, a memory layer with optional encrypted cloud sync. Repo / issues / PRs: https://github.com/risense-ai/respire-qoder · Site: https://rsrs.rs

plugins.name: respire-qoder
plugins.description: Memory layer for Qoder. The agent automatically recalls stored records before each answer; a prompt starting with "记：" writes to the store; a store check at the end of a turn reminds it to save what it just learned. Records are encrypted on the local machine; register on https://rsrs.rs and run rsrs register / rsrs login to sync them encrypted to the cloud (without an account, local only). No model required. Issues & PRs: https://github.com/risense-ai/respire-qoder
